description: This Java interface defines generic data access object (DAO) operations for entities, including CRUD operations, list retrieval, counting, and querying by field, using JPA Criteria API.

classes.name: SalesManagerEntityDao
classes.description: A generic DAO interface for managing entities with CRUD operations, queries, and metadata handling, parameterized by entity key and type.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Retrieves an entity by its class and identifier.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves an entity by its identifier.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the state of the given entity from the database.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns a list of all entities.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the total count of entities.

methods.name: countByField
methods.description: Counts entities matching a specific field value.

methods.name: listByField
methods.description: Lists entities matching a specific field value.

methods.name: getByField
methods.description: Retrieves a single entity matching a specific field value.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Lists entities with optional filtering, limit, offset, and ordering.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Counts entities matching a specified filter.

methods.name: getEntityManager
methods.description: Returns the JPA EntityManager used for persistence operations.
